nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text:
Recently,a lot of misinformation about HMPV(Human Metapneumovirus) has been spreading,so here is the truth to clarify the misconceptions.

HMPV is not a newly emerging https://t.co/Gb55oOVya0  was discovered in 2001,isolated from the respiratory samples of infants.

nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text: The name also suggests it's association with humans, and meta pneumo becoz of it's primarily impact on lower respiratory tract,causing symptoms similiar to pneumonia, particularly in children under 5 yrs old.

nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text: HMPV has a negative-sense RNA https://t.co/ncurQfrsTS other RNA viruses,it mutates,but mutation alone does not imply a pandemic potential.  But Why becoz SARS-COV-2(Covid too have RNA as genetic material🤔).

nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text:
Now,HMPV has a negative-sense RNA genome that requires transcription into positive-sense strand before protein synthesis.
 While SARS-COV-2 has a positive-sense RNA genome,which can directly translated into proteins by host's ribosomes, making it more effi in rep and adap.

nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text:
HMPV's genome is smaller and code for only 8-9 proteins,limiting it's ability to manipulate or evade the immune response.
SARS-COV-2 's large genome codes for 28-29 proteins, including multiple accessory proteins that enhances immune evasion,replication efficiency nd adaptability

nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text:
HMPV primarily causes localised outbreaks of resp illnesses.
HMPV Enters the respiratory tract,infects the epithelial cells in the respiratory mucosa and causes inflammation and swelling of the airways.
In infants and young childrens can also leads to hypoxia.

nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text:
Now it has normal rhino viral symptoms like cough,wheezing, fever,nasal congestion,shortness of breath,sore throat and fatigueness.
nd in more severe cases,it can lead to pneumonia and bronchiolitis.
It's main targets are infants and older aged ppl.

nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text: With SARS-COV-2 Primarily targets  upper and lower respiratory tract but it's effects can extend far beyond to many multiple organs. It enters human cells via ACE2 receptor (found in lungs,kidney, intestine, blood vessels, kidneys and brain).

nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text:
So HMPV can lead to severe disease in the population but generally not as transmissible or severe as SARS-COV-2.
While SARS structural and non structural proteins combined with it's rapid mutation in regions like spike protein,contributed to pandemic potential.

nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text:
HMPV's simpler genome makes it less capable for developing extensive resistance to antiviral drugs or evading immune response.
While SARS-COV-2 with it's accessory proteins and proofreading mechanisms can maintain genomic stability while evolving resistance to evading immunity.

nodes.author: SinoArtrialNode
nodes.text: So,no need to panic about this viral infection, it's generally self limiting and tends to resolve on its own. Until and unless it's not severe. So just focus on your immune system becoz it mainly effects on those having lower one.
